observed_structure: Each SIMDgroup owns one logical gate or up row, with eight row owners sharing a threadgroup.
SIMDgroup lanes walk packed char4 columns with a literal stride of 32.
Each lane converts one char4 weight vector to FP32, takes its dot product with the corresponding float4 input, and applies the row-local scale selected per 16 char4 values.
An FP32 register accumulates the scaled vector dot products before simd_sum reduces them across the SIMDgroup.
Lane zero publishes the reduced row value directly into the device gate-up buffer.
variant_notes: An out-of-range row returns the entire SIMDgroup before the lane-strided dot product.
Gate and up rows share one concatenated device buffer in the cited span.
